profile.headline: Architect Lead at Microsoft (Nuance)
profile.summary:
Currently working in the medical software development arena writing a next generation dicom based medical viewer and many of the supporting backend requirements. 

Prior to that I worked in the video game industry and business software development field as both a Technical Lead and a Developer.  Technical expertise includes Java/Spring, C# ASP.NET MVC4, javascript/jQuery/RESTful web services, actionscript, Objective-C, C++/MFC, Win32 SDK, Java EE, SQL, XML (including XPath, XML Schemas, XSLT) and networking.

positions.title: Senior Principal/Principal/Architect Lead
positions.description:
💡 PinAI
Architect on several initiatives to design a next generation greenfield effort to automate patient care and billing.  Designed and implemented APIs used to match patients with insurance subscribers using fuzzy logic that used patient name, age and zip code.  Designed and wrote import services to ingest subscribers to a normalized format for import into the PinAI database.

🖥️ HLS
Architect Lead on the PowerScribe One Radiology reporting client team. I was brought in to stabilize and modernize the application which suffered from stability and memory issues, taking lead of offshore teams on several overdue initiatives.
-Rewrote and modularized an antiquated logging system to be a proper, configurable ILogger enabling it to send logs to App Insights, an on-prem server and to disk. This was hugely impactful for enabling proactive issue tracking.  Later used in multiple projects.
-Converted to .NET
-Design to replace an obsolete IPC system using .NET Remoting with gRPC 
-Converted to 64bit which was complicated by external factors
-Led authentication design using app registration and certs, privacy/security reviews
-Led Tech Lead forum, mentoring, design and code reviews
-Multiple training sessions

This effort (~year) resulted in a more performant, stable environment, particularly with regard to memory. This allowed for a significant upgrade cycle to begin.

I next designed, led and coded an Azure hosted software updater service using blob storage to automate PowerScribe upgrades which are built on-prem as a ClickOnce deployment. The updater would identify the current version of PowerScribe and on-prem backend then query the server to find the next compatible upgrade. It would download all needed files, perform the build, deploy and verify. I was responsible for the UI, front end and back-end design, security considerations, coding, training and some deployment. This service should save thousands of hours of support time and increase upgrade velocity.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · .NET Core · ASP.NET MVC · C# · SQL · Security · Microsoft Azure · Blob Storage · Application Insights · Entity Framework

positions.title: Group Manager Enterprise Architect
positions.description:
Lead Architect on a supply chain integration hub for a major consumer products company which allowed for custom endpoints to interact with Dynamics 365 and process various financial documents.  System was designed to be highly scalable and fault tolerant using app services, Azure Functions and Azure Service Bus.  

Technical lead on a team of two tasked to perform a quality assessment for a top tier client experiencing major performance issues in a web-based benefits application. The assessment was very well received by the client resulting in them agreeing to have a larger team perform the improvements.  I then lead a team of 7+ engineers brought in to fix the issues found in the assessment which included numerous threading/async problems along with paging, database and client-side issues.  Performance gains were very significant lowering page load times for large table datasets down from 8+ minutes down to a few seconds.

Solution architect writing design documentation on a lift and shift of an on-prem Epic installation to Azure.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Multithreading · SQL · Entity Framework · Web Development

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Design and writing a next generation consumer app in React and .NET Core that makes heavy use of AI to change how users plan “activities”. The app is well into development and will continue to advance quickly with use of AI dev tools.

Designed and wrote a high end Scientific and Linear Algebra calculator that is able to handle numerous complex equations involving matrices, vectors, quaternions and planes among many other.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Linear Algebra · React.js · TypeScript · SQL

positions.title: Co-Founder/Architect
positions.description: Rueshare delivers industry leading PEG management capabilities allowing public access television to manage all aspects of their center, from member and asset management to classes and productions to reports and finance among many other features.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Entity Framework · SQL · jQuery · Bootstrap · Sales · Entrepreneurship · Software Architecture

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Concurrently maintained and extended the existing legacy .Net Framework solution while designing the next generation video surveillance product in .Net 6

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for all aspects of the backend associated with the SiteBuilder team which allows small to medium sized business to create their own website.  Highlights include four azure functions that range from tracking insights using Event Hubs to a Service Bus function that schedules posts to a time based function that reports on user statistics for Google My Business.  Other highlights include writing significant parts of the backend for the Google My Business integration and an unannounced follow on product, numerous additions to the Control Panel backend which allow users to design their site to the online store.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Multithreading · Azure Functions · SQL

positions.title: Sr. Developer/Visualization Engineer
positions.description:
SR. DEVELOPER/ARCHITECT | LIFEIMAGE | AUG 2009-PRESENT
Co-architected a service, written in .NET Core, as a cross platform router for sending medical images to a connection based on a set of rules.  Images can be routed and filtered from one connection to another through a simple JSON file.  Connections consist of our lifeIMAGE cloud (where I did a significant amount of coding in support of LITE), PACS, HL7 and the file system.  The app makes heavy use of networking and the TPL (Task processing library) and was a very high priority project that was done in a very timely manner with a development team of two.

Senior developer responsible for numerous parts of our cloud Java back end ranging from controllers to business logic to the database.  Task have included single sign-on (SAML), interoperability with our enterprise product, communication and sharing of data between users among many others.

Lead on the development of an extensive medical viewer along with supporting functionality on the Java backend.  The backend used JMS queues to handle conversion of both images and multiframe videos.  The videos were converted in a multithreaded environment for maximum efficiency. Functionality of the client side was extensive supporting window/level, reference lines, annotations, multiframe video, autoscroll, cine of non-multiframe images, zoom, pan, and multiviewport. Extensive use of linear algebra.

Lead on a C# middle tier for supporting third party apps.  This dll uses extensive multithreading and webapis to upload massive amounts of data to our cloud and web offerings.  This dll is currently being used by third parties and our own desktop uploader.

In an effort to better gauge our performance I lead an effort to write an extensive jMeter script to measure the load on both or enterprise and cloud products.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Hibernate · C# · .NET Core · LINQ to SQL · Linear Algebra · jQuery · JavaScript · TypeScript · DICOM · Actionscript

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the development of ONI’s first in-house three viewer GSL which consisted of an ATL/COM based set of classes that handled the visual display of DICOM images along with a ATL/COM based dialog box that displayed various text fields and an intermediary COM class that used connection points to communicate with both.  

			The viewer portion consisted of three viewers that displayed a series of user specified scans, usually in a dif-ferent orientation.  Along with the images, each window displayed the DICOM annotations and a group of cut lines that could be moved and rotated in sync between all three viewers.  The entire viewer subsystem existed on an MFC based dialog box that helped coordinate interaction. Since no 3D engine was utilized significant amounts of linear algebra was used to display, rotate and move the images along with other aspects of setting up the scan.  Other duties included significant upgrades to the software layer that communicated with several hardware devices including an RF amplifier, Gradient Amplifier and MMU, a JavaScript based installer of our user manuals and other smaller COM controls.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · COM · Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC) · Linear Algebra · Physics · DICOM

positions.title: Head of Development, Architect
positions.description: I was brought in by the president of a former company to lead a pre-funding startup during off hours.  I lead and architected the development of a production ready prototype of a massive multiplayer online educational product written in C++ with 3D graphics (using the Ogre engine) extensive networking (TCP/IP) and multi-threading.  I was responsible for all aspects of both the client and server side architecture including the graphics layer, AI, the data layer and networking layer.  Other management duties consisted of mentoring the other engineers who had no game development experience, producing many documents including technical design documents, product demos and updating the team on the progress of the prototype. The team consisted of three engineers (who I managed), several artists based in China, two designers and the president of the compa-ny.  The project was successfully completed in approximately nine months resulting in seven million dollars of funding. The company which is now largely staffed in China.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Multithreading · Graphics · Direct3D

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description: Duties focused on handling a large majority of Microsoft TCR coding for the Xbox 360, XBox live and net-work coding (TCP/IP) along with a smaller amount of user interface and graphics tasks. I designed and imple-mented the Xbox Live implementation including the network layer, game lobbying, connecting and game launch along with invitations and game ranking.  I took over much of user interface engine from a departed engineer since I have extensive UI experience in both the business and game development arena.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Direct3D · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Multithreading

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description: Duties include architecting and developing next generation real time strategy video games for the PC platform on two published titles. Subsystems worked on include game logic, physics engine, networking engine, and user interface and all written in C++.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Linear Algebra · Direct3D · Multithreading · Physics
